[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-5w[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Successor Links: a closed planned task hands its slot to the tasks [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]it unblocks[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]When a Bob close gesture completes a task planned in today's [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]ledger, every direct dependent that this close fully unblocked is [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]linked into the predecessor's slot and becomes Next in the same [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]write. Bob close gestures are Obsidian Ctrl+Enter, `bob capture` [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`!note:id`, and the `=x…` / `=!` Pomodoro closes. The slot is right[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]after the predecessor's Task Link, or the same-name continuation [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]when the whole session closed. One grouped notice says what was [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]linked, where, and why: a card in Obsidian, the live preview plus [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]one notification line in Bob Mac Capture, and rows in the CLI. [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Capture gets faster, not slower: on apollo, plain and `=x` previews[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]take ≤ 40 ms, and closing a real prerequisite takes ≤ 70 ms.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]11[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
